newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures end week firm on budget hopes.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures end week firm on budget hopes.

text.p: May 2 - U.S. debt futures ended the week firm on hopes for a budget deal. Talk circulated in last two hours of trade that a deal was at hand. After the close a senior official announced a budget deal had been reached. One analyst said budget news could give market a bid Monday, but noted quarterly refunding looms. June T-bond reached resistance at 109-28/32 to 30/32 late, but trade very quiet.
